reviews.title: Wow what happened ?!
reviews.text: Word swag used to be a good app. For years now they were all I used.  Now, all the sudden you can’t get the words to line up or go where you want them to and it has a mind of its own even with the auto break off you cannot get the words to lineup nor space out . Does not give me any control over where I put my words anymore so like it has a bug or something..
